description: Bet `amount` COOK at Dice Club: win if the roll (0.00–99.99) lands under `chance` %. A win pays stake × (100 − edge) / chance (1% edge: 50% → 1.98x, 10% → 9.9x); a loss loses the stake. Gambling with real COOK — only roll when the user asked to. The house's keeper settles the bet within seconds by revealing the next seed of a chain it committed to up front; this server generates the client seed that goes into the roll (random, or `clientSeed`), waits for the settle and re-derives the roll from the revealed seed (`proof.verified`, plus a link to the site's verifier). Returns `won` / `lost` with the net, or `pending` if the keeper is slower than `waitSeconds` (check later with get_dice_bets). Members only: the wallet must hold a verified Cookie Chads NFT. Refused before sending when the stake is under the minimum, over the bankroll cap at that chance, the table is paused or full, or the wallet can't cover it (bet account rent ~0.002 COOK, refunded at settle). Requires a signer: COOKIE_PRIVATE_KEY locally, or in external-signer mode this returns `needs_signature` for the user's wallet to sign (see submit_signed_tx).

chance.description: win chance in percent, e.g. 50 (0.01–98.99, at most two decimals)

clientSeed.description: your own seed: 64 hex chars, or any text (hashed); default: random

waitSeconds.description: how long to wait for the keeper to settle (default 45; 0 = return once placed)
